title: The arrow keys, Delete and Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V act on the selection
body:
Jack allowed these keys on 2026-11-24 (see CLAUDE.md).

## Proposal

- With a selection, each arrow key press moves it 1 pixel through `move_edits`; with none, Left and Right step a frame as before.
- Delete deletes the selected nodes through `delete_edits`, or shows why not.
- Ctrl+C puts the selected nodes' source on the clipboard; Ctrl+V pastes acre source from the clipboard through `paste_edits` and selects the pasted nodes.
- Shift+Enter in the text field starts a new line.
- None fire while a text field has focus, except Shift+Enter inside it.
